rea.description: REA: binary, package, browser and runtime analysis
rea.install: Node.js 22.23.4+, 24.22.1+, or 26.12.1+; the launcher uses npx and the pinned package version

mcp-emulate.description: CPU emulation, disassembly, assembly and trace tools
mcp-emulate.install: uv with Python 3.11 and MCP SDK 1.30.0 compatibility pins

86box.description: 86Box whole-PC control with optional GDB debugger tools
86box.install: One shared checkout and server venv per host; build with AUTOMATION=ON. Add GDBSTUB=ON for debugger tools. TCP transport is default; set GAMEFRAME_86BOX_TRANSPORT=unix when socket sharing works.
